cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll be honest about my birthday. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. He came for dessert. By dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

mechanism: A rules on the meanings of dinner and eating so each photo challenge still fits a narrower claim of honesty.
confusable: Unlike correcting a simple misunderstanding once, A repeatedly shrinks the truthful interval when new evidence arrives.
comparison: Birthday company and carving photograph differ from contents and geographic arrival.
seedUse: The seed's stipulated meal definitions already enact S01's control over which details may count.
